---
title: "Guides"
subtitle: "Executable, run-it-for-real walkthroughs"
---

These guides mirror the *tutorials* section of the production Docusaurus site,
but every code cell is **executed at build time** — the polars / pandas frames
you see are the genuine output of `sportsdataverse` against the live ESPN
endpoints as of the render, frozen into the static page.

| Guide | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [Installation](installation.qmd) | pip / uv / conda install, Python & engine versions, optional extras, verifying the import. |
| [Teams & scoreboard](teams-and-scoreboard.qmd) | The uniform `espn_<sport>_teams()` surface and a past-dated scoreboard across multiple leagues. |
| [Schedule & rosters](schedule-and-rosters.qmd) | Team schedules and rosters, and how `team_id` flows through the endpoints. |
| [The parser layer](parsed-dataframes.qmd) | `return_parsed` / `return_as_pandas`, and how raw ESPN JSON becomes a tidy frame. |

::: {.callout-tip}
Each guide is a single `.qmd` file. To reproduce any of them locally:

```bash
cd docs-quarto
quarto render guides/teams-and-scoreboard.qmd
```
:::
